senses.en: put sth. into a small space, esp. in order to protect, hide, carry, or hold it
examples: [[Tuck]] your gloves in your pocket so that you don't lose them.
The new housekeeper [[tucked]] the bottom of the sheet under the mattress as she was taught to.

senses.en: push a loose end of a piece of clothing or material into a particular place or position, esp. to make it tidy or comfortable
examples: [[Tuck]] your gloves in your pocket so that you don't lose them.
The new housekeeper [[tucked]] the bottom of the sheet under the mattress as she was taught to.

senses.en: without any serious interest or attention
examples: He gave us a [[casual]] glance as he walked by, but didn't stop.
His eyes were angry, though he sounded [[casual]].

senses.zh: 漫不经心的；不放在心上的
senses.en: relaxed and not worried, or seeming not to care about sth.
examples: He gave us a [[casual]] glance as he walked by, but didn't stop.
His eyes were angry, though he sounded [[casual]].

senses.zh: （有趣或有价值事物的）碰巧发现，机缘巧合
senses.en: (literary) when interesting or valuable discoveries are made by accident
examples: Meeting her like that, and there of all places, was true [[serendipity]]!

senses.zh: 如饥似渴地阅读；津津有味地看
senses.en: read sth. quickly and eagerly, or watch sth. with great interest
examples: She spent several evenings [[devouring]] the science fiction books borrowed from the library.
After the tennis match the boys [[devoured]] the sandwiches in seconds.

senses.en: eat sth. quickly because you are very hungry
examples: She spent several evenings [[devouring]] the science fiction books borrowed from the library.
After the tennis match the boys [[devoured]] the sandwiches in seconds.

senses.en: (in the ~ of sth.) (fml.) in the middle of a very difficult situation
examples: The country is presently in the [[throes]] of a profound economic crisis.

senses.en: (fml.) when sth. changes from one form or state to another
examples: Sometimes, making the [[transition]] from adolescence (青春期) to adulthood can be painful.
Having been in the position for over 10 years, Jack will finally [[transition]] to his new role next month.

senses.en: change to a new state or start using sth. new
examples: Sometimes, making the [[transition]] from adolescence (青春期) to adulthood can be painful.
Having been in the position for over 10 years, Jack will finally [[transition]] to his new role next month.

senses.en: the main church of a particular area under the control of a bishop
examples: The old city around the [[cathedral]] is the most colorful part of town.

senses.en: (pl. metros)

senses.zh: 说明问题的；显露真相的
senses.en: showing the true character or nature of sb. / sth., often without being intended
examples: The tomb stands today as a [[telling]] memorial to the period.

senses.en: a piece of information that quickly gives you an idea of what the situation is like at a particular time
examples: The book gives us a [[snapshot]] of life in the Middle Ages.
He takes [[snapshots]] with a simple camera.

senses.en: a photograph taken quickly and often not very skillfully
examples: The book gives us a [[snapshot]] of life in the Middle Ages.
He takes [[snapshots]] with a simple camera.

senses.en: almost; practically
examples: He was [[virtually]] unknown in the community before running for office.
With the new technology, the tour of a museum can be done [[virtually]].

senses.en: on a computer, rather than in the real world
examples: He was [[virtually]] unknown in the community before running for office.
With the new technology, the tour of a museum can be done [[virtually]].

senses.en: (usu. passive) become or form a fossil by being preserved in rock
examples: In Wyoming, I visited a rock shop made entirely of [[fossilized]] dinosaur bones.
Most couples, however [[fossilized]] their relationship, have some interests in common.

senses.en: if people, ideas, systems, etc. fossilize or are fossilized, they never change or develop, even when there are good reasons why they should change
examples: In Wyoming, I visited a rock shop made entirely of [[fossilized]] dinosaur bones.
Most couples, however [[fossilized]] their relationship, have some interests in common.

senses.zh: 火山的；由火山作用引起的
senses.en: relating to or caused by a volcano
examples: Geologists understand many of the factors that cause [[volcanic]] eruptions.

senses.en: sth. that makes an unpleasant situation better
examples: Regular exercise is the best [[antidote]] to tiredness and depression.
There is no known [[antidote]] to a bite from this snake.

senses.en: a substance that stops the effects of a poison
examples: Regular exercise is the best [[antidote]] to tiredness and depression.
There is no known [[antidote]] to a bite from this snake.

senses.en: the art, profession, or method of producing photographs or the scenes in films
examples: After I went on a [[photography]] course, my friend asked me to take some photos of her.

senses.zh: 英国维多利亚（女王）时代的
（艺术、音乐、电影等的）评论家，批评家
senses.en: sb. whose job is to make judgments about the good and bad qualities of art, music, films, etc.
examples: The play has been well received by the [[critics]].
[[Critics]] of the scheme have said that it will not solve the problem of teenage crime.

senses.en: sb. who criticizes a person, organization, or idea
examples: The play has been well received by the [[critics]].
[[Critics]] of the scheme have said that it will not solve the problem of teenage crime.

senses.en: draw a sketch of sth.
examples: The art students were told to [[sketch]] the landscape.
Cantor drew a rough [[sketch]] of his apartment.

senses.en: a simple, quickly made drawing that does not show much detail
examples: The art students were told to [[sketch]] the landscape.
Cantor drew a rough [[sketch]] of his apartment.

senses.en: (jotted, jotting) (~ down) write a short piece of information quickly
examples: Let me [[jot down]] your number and I'll call you tomorrow.

senses.en: repeat an idea or opinion because you agree with it
examples: I've heard the prime minister's view [[echoed]] throughout the party.
Her scream was followed by a loud [[echo]].

senses.en: (pl. echoes) a sound that you hear again after a loud noise, because it was made near sth. such as a wall
examples: I've heard the prime minister's view [[echoed]] throughout the party.
Her scream was followed by a loud [[echo]].

senses.en: showing careful consideration or attention
examples: It is a [[thoughtful]] and finely acted film, suggesting that no one has a fixed nature.
It was really [[thoughtful]] of you to remember my birthday.

senses.zh: 想得周到的；体贴的；关心的
senses.en: always thinking of the things you can do to make people happy or comfortable
examples: It is a [[thoughtful]] and finely acted film, suggesting that no one has a fixed nature.
It was really [[thoughtful]] of you to remember my birthday.

senses.zh: （尤指完成困难事情的）能力，才干
senses.en: the natural ability, skill, or power that makes a machine, person, or organization able to do sth., esp. sth. difficult
examples: I can speak French, but simultaneous interpretation is beyond my [[capabilities]].

senses.en: make a layer of sth. or put sth. down in layers
examples: The cliffs are [[layered]] with fossil remains.
The moon was shining through a thin [[layer]] of cloud.

senses.en: an amount or piece of a material or substance that covers a surface or that is between two other things
examples: The cliffs are [[layered]] with fossil remains.
The moon was shining through a thin [[layer]] of cloud.

senses.zh: 使增加到最大限度；使最大化
senses.en: (BrE also maximise) increase sth. such as profit or income as much as possible
examples: The aim of everyone, irrespective of weight, should be to change their eating habits to [[maximize]] the health benefits.

senses.en: very carefully
examples: The detective watched him [[closely]], waiting for a reply.
I have been [[closely]] involved in the work of both committees.

senses.en: to a very great degree
examples: The detective watched him [[closely]], waiting for a reply.
I have been [[closely]] involved in the work of both committees.

senses.en: with no information removed
examples: The radio station provides millions of people with [[unfiltered]] news.
[[Unfiltered]] apple juice is such a treat when it's in season in the fall.

senses.en: not having had solids removed with a filter
examples: The radio station provides millions of people with [[unfiltered]] news.
[[Unfiltered]] apple juice is such a treat when it's in season in the fall.

senses.en: (BrE moustache) hair that grows on a man's upper lip
examples: The old man had wavy hair, wore a thin [[mustache]], and was dressed conservatively.

senses.en: a period of thinking carefully about sth. or telling people your thoughts about it
examples: We had to sit and listen to his [[musings]] on life.

senses.en: if you cherish sth., it is very important to you
examples: I [[cherish]] the memory of that day.

senses.zh: （通过低声耳语和轻柔的身体动作）训练动物的人
senses.en: a person who can control and train a particular type of animal just by using the voice and gentle body movements, and without using force or threats
examples: He's the original horse [[whisperer]]! He could get on the back of any horse in half an hour.

senses.en: hit sth. gently, and often repeatedly, esp. making short, sharp noises
examples: Mark [[tapped]] his fingers on the tabletop impatiently.
I gave her a [[tap]] on the shoulder and she turned around.

senses.zh: （尤指为了引起某人注意）轻轻敲击，轻扣，轻拍
senses.en: an act of hitting sth. lightly, esp. to get sb.'s attention
examples: Mark [[tapped]] his fingers on the tabletop impatiently.
I gave her a [[tap]] on the shoulder and she turned around.

senses.en: in a way that feels warm, comfortable, and protected
examples: Jamie was [[snugly]] wrapped in a white woolen scarf.

senses.en: a line of colour, esp. one of several lines of color all close together
examples: She wore a bright green jogging suit with a white [[stripe]] down the sides.

senses.en: having lines or bands of color
examples: The suspect was tall, and wore dark blue trousers with a blue and white [[striped]] shirt.

senses.en: continue to exist for a long time
examples: He wasn't the only one who doubted the relationship would [[endure]].
It seemed impossible that anyone could [[endure]] such pain.

senses.en: be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining
examples: He wasn't the only one who doubted the relationship would [[endure]].
It seemed impossible that anyone could [[endure]] such pain.

senses.en: lasting for a long time
examples: One of my most [[enduring]] memories is of going on holiday to France with my parents.

senses.en: a group of words taken from a text or speech and repeated by sb. other than the original author or speaker
examples: The following [[quotation]] is taken from a 19th-century travel diary.

senses.zh: 为某事本身的缘故；鉴于某事本身的价值
senses.en: (for sth.'s ~ / for the ~ of it / for its own ~) because of the interest or value sth. has, not because of the advantages it may bring
examples: I don't care about winning or losing; I just enjoy playing sports for sports’ [[sake]].
The family moved to a coastal city in the south for the [[sake]] of the boy's health.

senses.zh: 为了某人 / 某事的缘故
senses.en: (for the ~ of sb. / sth.; for sb.'s / sth.'s ~) in order to help, improve, or please sb. / sth.
examples: I don't care about winning or losing; I just enjoy playing sports for sports’ [[sake]].
The family moved to a coastal city in the south for the [[sake]] of the boy's health.

senses.en: do what you are told or expected to do
examples: The little girl made no effort to [[obey]].

senses.en: refuse to do what a person, law, order, etc. tells you to do; refuse to obey
examples: If you [[disobey]] the law, you will be punished.

senses.en: having long sharp points
examples: Some corals are quite smooth, while others are sharp and [[spiky]].

senses.en: move slowly from one side to another
examples: The movement of the ship caused the mast (桅杆) to [[sway]] back and forth.

senses.en: find or discover sth. by chance and unexpectedly
examples: Workmen [[stumbled upon]] the relic while digging the foundations for a new building.

senses.zh: 把（尤指钱）存放在安全处
senses.en: (infml.) store sth. esp. money, in a safe place
examples: The envelope was [[tucked away]] in her jewel box.

senses.en: finally succeed or defeat other people or things
examples: It remains to be seen whether the archaeologists will [[win out]] over the urban planners.

senses.en: mention a subject or start to talk about it
examples: Why did you have to [[bring up]] the subject of money?

senses.zh: 甚至可能（用于提出更极端的说法）
senses.en: perhaps even (used to introduce a more extreme term than one first mentioned)
examples: They cost thousands if not millions of pounds to build.

senses.en: (AmE) at once; instantaneously
examples: Smart meters show in real time how much electricity and gas is being used by households.

senses.en: improve sth. by changing it slightly or adding a little more to it
examples: We thought the photo had probably been [[touched up]], because he looked so much younger in it.

senses.zh: 开始获得成功；取得进展
senses.en: start to be successful
examples: Construction of the theme park never [[got off the ground]] for lack of money.

senses.en: make sb. remember sth. or think about it again
examples: The photographs [[brought back]] many pleasant memories.

senses.zh: 步某人的后尘；走某人走过的路；继承事业
senses.en: do as another person did before, esp. in making a journey or following a particular career
examples: She wanted to follow in her mother's footsteps and be a ballroom dancer.
